senses.gloss: m. (enlargement of טרך or טרק, v. טָרֵיךְ, a. טְרַק I) [a wine-stirrer,] a board on which drinks for the table are mixed, side-board (abacus, mensa delphica), a plain board attached to the wall with hinges, to be put up and down (cmp. דְּלִפְקִי, Kel. XXV, 1).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 3:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. III, 3</cite> <he>ט׳ חלק</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 25:1">Kel. XXV, 1</cite> <he>טרכוס וחלק</he>) a plain tray (without rims). Ib. I, 12 <he>ט׳ שעשה וכ׳</he> a side-board under which they placed a piece of wood, formed like a spear (as an improvised support) for eating at it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:2">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:2">XV</cite>), 2 <cite ref="V01058"><he>תרקוש</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>ט׳</he>, by cler. error <cite ref="M02767"><he>מרקוש</he></cite>).
